subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` be a public config key that applies to both embedded and local OpenClaw compaction while Codex-native compaction warns that it is ignored?
rationale: This is new config surface, and repository policy treats config/default additions plus runtime scope limitations as compatibility-sensitive maintainer direction rather than a purely mechanical patch decision.

options.title: Repair local coverage before merge
options.body: Apply the config-derived value to both local manual and auto compaction, keep the Codex-native warning, and require focused tests plus redacted proof.

options.title: Narrow to embedded-only
options.body: Keep the embedded implementation but change help/docs so users know local and Codex-native compaction do not honor this key.

options.title: Pause for broader compaction override design
options.body: Hold this PR until a maintainer-sponsored compaction override design covers model, provider, and thinking behavior consistently.

recommendation.title: Repair local coverage before merge
recommendation.body: Apply the config-derived value to both local manual and auto compaction, keep the Codex-native warning, and require focused tests plus redacted proof.
